title: Stress selected-runtime memory and guest-pointer boundaries
goal: Exercise actual selected SDK memory services with synthetic and hash-bound MW3 geometry before trusting guest pointers or allocator behavior.
acceptance: Test virtual/physical aliases, endian access, allocation/release/alignment, reserve/commit/protect, stack guards, 32-bit wrap and invalid guest ranges
Use a standalone game-free test project and isolated profiles; no shared SDK patch or scheduler/interface changes without a separate agreed task
Preserve failed assertions and identify SDK limitations; synthetic geometry tests are not real title memory or performance evidence
validation: Run seeded allocator/range stress and meaningful negative pointer/guard cases with bounded subprocesses
Run Linux native plus supported ASan/UBSan checks; document Windows coverage or its dependency on MW3-040
